title: Local block normal form for a nonempty open subscheme
statement: Let the hypotheses of lem-pc-constant-rank-map-local-normal-form hold, and assume in addition that Z is nonempty. Then for every z in Z there are an open neighbourhood U of z and isomorphisms eS and eT of the restricted finite free modules with the (m-a) plus a and a plus (n-a) biproducts, respectively, such that the restricted map is eS.hom followed by the projection to the second source summand, the inclusion of the first target summand, and eT.inv.

source.place: normal-form claim and local kernel/image splitting

proof.text: Fix z and choose R, g from hrank. Choose x in Spec R and use the singleton image equality to obtain g(x)=j(z). Apply the proved source-library le_rank_map_appTop_iff to a≤rank, obtaining row and column lists whose minor determinant is nonvanishing at j(z).
Apply exists_local_invertible_minor_block to this specified nonvanishing minor, obtaining U containing z and biproduct bases eS,eT with invertible leading component f of F=eS.inv≫ψ≫eT.hom.

Use Mathlib CategoryTheory.Biprod.gaussian F (Preadditive/Biproducts.lean:788) to construct L,Q,δ with L.hom≫F≫Q.hom=biprod.map f δ. It uses the explicitly invertible unitriangular block matrices with off-diagonal components minus C f⁻¹ and minus f⁻¹ B; multiplication cancels the off-diagonal components and leaves D-C f⁻¹ B. Set eS′=eS≪≫L.symm and eT′=eT≪≫Q. Inverse identities give ψ=eS′.hom≫biprod.map f δ≫eT′.inv.
Turn each rank equality supplied by hrank into the upper bound rank≤a on U and apply complementary_block_eq_zero_of_rank_le to the given diagonal equality. This gives δ=0.

Set B=biprod.mapIso (asIso f) (Iso.refl _) and C=biprod.braiding. The biproduct projection identities give biprod.map f 0=B.hom≫C.hom≫biprod.snd≫biprod.inl. Therefore eS′≪≫B≪≫C and eT′ have the exact source and target summand orders in the conclusion and give the displayed equality. This is the final hom_ext/simp calculation in Lean.

The last theorem requires a square matrix over a field; not this reduced-ring, rectangular local statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_normal_form_of_constantRank_nonempty
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] [Nonempty Z] {M N : Y.Modules} {m n : ℕ}
    (eM : M ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
    (eN : N ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
    (φ : M ⟶ N) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsField R) (g : Spec R ⟶ Y),
      Set.range g.base = {j.base z} ∧
      ((freeMatrix (eM.inv ≫ φ ≫ eN.hom)).map g.appTop).rank = a) :
    ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Z.Opens, z ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (eS : ((Modules.pullback j).obj M).restrict U.ι ≅
          free (ULift.{u} (Fin (m - a))) ⊞ free (ULift.{u} (Fin a)))
        (eT : ((Modules.pullback j).obj N).restrict U.ι ≅
          free (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) ⊞ free (ULift.{u} (Fin (n - a)))),
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).map ((Modules.pullback j).map φ) =
          eS.hom ≫ biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inl ≫ eT.inv
